items.name: Pine Needle Tea
items.desc: Bitter green tea steeped from Sumikage pines. Restores 60 HP to one ally.

items.name: Plum Rice Ball
items.desc: Grandmother Tsuru's sour-plum onigiri, wrapped in paper. Restores 150 HP to one ally.

items.name: Lantern Incense
items.desc: A coil of shrine incense. Its warm smoke restores 70 HP to the whole party.

items.name: Vermilion Drop
items.desc: One bead of red ink sealed in wax. Adds 35 to one ally's ink gauge.

items.name: Cinnabar Cake
items.desc: A pressed stick of pure red ink, rare and heavy. Adds 100 to one ally's ink gauge.

items.name: Ember Charm
items.desc: A paper charm painted with a flame. Thrown, it bursts for Ember damage to one foe.

items.name: Tide Charm
items.desc: A paper charm painted with a wave. Thrown, it bursts for Tide damage to one foe.

items.name: Gale Charm
items.desc: A paper charm painted with a swirl of wind. Thrown, it bursts for Gale damage to one foe.

items.name: Stone Charm
items.desc: A paper charm painted with a mountain. Thrown, it bursts for Stone damage to one foe.

items.name: Dawn Charm
items.desc: A gold-flecked charm painted with a sunrise. It burns away Blot-ink with Dawn damage.
